protocol.label: Experimental — limited training data.
protocol.family: Locally trained ridge-regularised recursive AR(6); not a pretrained neural time-series model
protocol.selectionRule: Lowest pooled earlier-validation AR MAE on identical pairs; lexical tie break; no test-day tuning
protocol.alignmentRule: Predict any unpublished current interval internally, then return only the next 24 future interval starts
protocol.gapRule: Require six contiguous exact origin-known lags; never fill gaps or shift rows across missing periods
protocol.diagnosticPurpose: ALREADY_SEEN_DIAGNOSTIC; complete later days in the frozen known dataset, not independent confirmation
